# HR-Stack

> HR-Stack is an employee management application for managing employees, attendance, finance, announcements, and support tickets. It includes a dashboard for administrators and employees.

## Core Features
- [Login](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/login): Access the HR-Stack dashboard.
- [Attendance](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/): Track and manage attendance via OTP or QR codes.
- [Announcements](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/): Company-wide announcements and updates.
- [App Releases](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/): Manage and view application release notes.
- [Support Tickets](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/support): Submit and manage internal support requests.

## Admin Tools
- [Employees Directory](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/): Manage employee records, profiles, and documents.
- [Admins Directory](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/): Manage administrator accounts.
- [Finance](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/): Manage salary structures and generate salary slips.

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/privacy-policy): Data handling and privacy practices.
- [FAQ / Help](https://purvesh0227.github.io/hr-stack-frontend/help): Frequently asked questions.
